about: Merchant conversations for `php artisan chat:eval`. Store data is FakeStoreData: orders 1042, 1055-1058; products Denim Jacket, Blue Hoodie, Beanie, Leather Belt (draft); refund + shipping policies; WELCOME10 + free shipping discounts. group: owner = written by the store owner (the user), seen = wording from real testing (rules were tuned on it), fresh = new wording for a real need. expect = one entry per question in the message, in order; intent and target may list several acceptable values; a target ending in * matches by prefix. known_gap = the app cannot do this yet, so a failure is expected.
